did: Built home's half of CONVEYOR3 in server#851: home files a Studio take's pickup (its labels and what was heard, never its comment or audio) once heard, built once so a retry resends the same bytes, and reads the routine's picked answer to move the take to picked-up only from the ready move it names by number; three fresh-context review rounds converged, and the follow-ups are filed as server#850 and server#852.

calls.title: Where a pickup's bytes live
options: the existing mailbox_outgoing, keyed by name
calls.why: mailbox_outgoing is already append-only, holds one body per name and is handed until answered, which is exactly keeping the first bytes; no new store for the ledger
calls.undo: add a table and backfill it from mailbox_outgoing where folder='pickup'

calls.title: The picked-up move's at
options: home's clock when the answer is kept
calls.why: picked carries no time; invariant 2 never orders by at; home's clock is when home learned it

calls.title: Archive pickup and picked now
options: leave them live and file an issue
calls.why: the Worker's archive role for these folders is unknown, and archiving would add two listings to every idle pass beyond the agreed six

calls.title: A picked answer for a ready move the take has left
calls.why: the agreed shape moves the take only while that seq is newest, and keeping the file keeps the record that the issue exists
calls.undo: add a refusal kind in mailbox::pass::keep

calls.title: Renaming the MI6 idle-pass test
options: rename it and keep the old name in a doc line
calls.why: the count is now 26, and text containment keeps any ledger proof holding through the switch
calls.undo: drop the doc line once the ledger names the new test

server#852: a refused pickup is final and silent; match home's label rule to the Worker's
drop the old MI6 test name from pass.rs's doc comment once some-ui's ledger names the new one
